title: CodeBuddy and WorkBuddy Extend the Free Trial of Hy3 Model Until August 31st
excerpt: CodeBuddy and WorkBuddy officially announced that the limited-time free trial of the Hy3 model has been extended to August 31, 2026. Due to the enthusiastic use
content_html:
CodeBuddy and WorkBuddy officially announced that the limited-time free trial of the Hy3 model has been extended to August 31, 2026. Due to the enthusiastic user feedback, the official decided to continue offering free access to the model, providing users with more opportunities to test the model's capabilities.

According to the introduction, Hy3 is a large language model that currently focuses on text-based tasks and does not have multimodal capabilities. When users use CodeBuddy or WorkBuddy to call Hy3 for tasks such as video or image generation, the system will automatically switch to the corresponding multimodal model and consume points according to normal rules.

The official stated that due to the rapid increase in the number of participants in the free trial activity, to ensure user experience, the platform has reasonably allocated daily free call quotas. During peak times, users may be placed in a queue, and the page will indicate when the quota will be restored. According to the official recommendation, resources are relatively abundant between 11:00 PM and 8:00 AM the next day, and users can choose to experience during off-peak hours.

This extension of the Hy3 free trial further expands the testing scope of the model's capabilities for users. As part of the joint project between CodeBuddy and WorkBuddy, the Hy3 model will continue to collect user feedback and promote the optimization of model capabilities in scenarios such as AI programming and smart office work.

content_html_zh:
CodeBuddy和WorkBuddy官方宣布Hy3车型限时免费试用期延长至2026年8月31日。 由于用户的热烈反馈，官方决定继续提供模型的免费访问，为用户提供更多测试模型能力的机会。

据介绍，Hy3是一个大型语言模型，目前专注于基于文本的任务，不具备多模态能力。 当用户使用CodeBuddy或WorkBuddy调用Hy3进行视频或图像生成等任务时，系统会自动切换到相应的多模态模型并按照正常规则消耗积分。

官方表示，由于免费试用活动参与人数快速增加，为保证用户体验，平台合理分配每日免费通话额度。 在高峰时段，用户可能会被置于队列中，页面会指示何时恢复配额。 根据官方推荐，晚上11:00至次日上午8:00之间资源相对丰富，用户可以选择非高峰时段体验。

Hy3免费试用的此次延期，进一步扩大了用户对该模型能力的测试范围。 作为CodeBuddy和WorkBuddy联合项目的一部分，Hy3模型将持续收集用户反馈，推动模型能力在AI编程、智能办公等场景的优化。
